title: redact leaves a GUID that follows a hyphen, which the leak scan flags, so query-log delivery stalls
goal: redact.redact replaces every GUID that kbcommon.leak_hits flags as guid, a GUID that follows a hyphen (a docs URL slug such as some-page-<guid>) included, so a redacted query-log row never fails the store's leak scan and apply --push does not stall on it; kb/_self/querylog.md says the redactor and the scan agree on a hyphen-led GUID

run: import sys; sys.path.insert(0, '_tools'); import redact, kbcommon; g = '-'.join(('3f2a9c1e', '7b4d', '4e8a', '9c21', '5d6e7f8a9b0c')); out = redact.redact('/en-us/troubleshoot/some-page-' + g); sys.exit(0 if not [h for h in kbcommon.leak_hits(out) if h[0] == 'guid'] else 1)

import sys; sys.path.insert(0, '_tools'); import redact; g = '-'.join(('3f2a9c1e', '7b4d', '4e8a', '9c21', '5d6e7f8a9b0c')); z = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'; sys.exit(0 if redact.redact('id ' + g + ' and ' + z) == 'id ' + z + ' and ' + z else 1)
import sys; t = open('kb/_self/querylog.md', encoding='utf-8').read(); sys.exit(0 if 'hyphen-led GUID' in t else 1)

kb/_self/querylog.md says the redactor and the scan agree on a hyphen-led GUID

notes: Found 2026-10-22: query-log delivery was refused from 2026-10-21 15:38 to 2026-10-22 (59 runs, 49 entries undelivered) because fetches[6].path of two run files ended in a docs URL GUID slug: redact.GUID (_tools/redact.py:52) has (?<![\w-]) so it skips a GUID after '-', while kbcommon.LEAK_GUID (_tools/kbcommon.py:219) uses \b and flags it. Worked around with querylog.py reredact (backup store-reredact-20261022T221812Z), check then problems=0. The next such fetch stalls delivery again. Planned: the filed repro planted a GUID of repeated letters that kb/public already holds, so redact.known() keeps it even without a hyphen and a lookbehind fix would not turn it green; rewritten with a GUID kb/public lacks, built at run time from parts (a literal GUID in repro.run fails check). Ran the rewrite: redact.redact leaves the hyphen-led GUID whole, kbcommon.leak_hits returns a guid hit, exit 1. A plain GUID is replaced, so the defect is the (?<![\w-]) lookbehind at redact.py:52 against \b at kbcommon.py:219. _tools/mon_view.py:82 reads redact.GUID.findall on a window, so a lookbehind change reaches it: touched to re-read. Docs map: kb/_self/map.csv:123 maps querylog.md to redact.py. Checks: a plain GUID still becomes the placeholder and the placeholder stays; querylog.md names a hyphen-led GUID (fails until the doc is edited).
